style: Rap radio segment, late-night New York FM, 1997, played as a station countdown bit. Singer A is the MC: deep low male rapper, smooth and unhurried, mellow near-whisper right on the microphone, calm menace, laid-back flow sitting slightly behind the beat, rapped and spoken only, no melody. Singer B is the radio host: a loud brash hype jock who only calls out the chart positions, excited, squashed AM-style compression and slapback on his voice alone. Two different people, never blended. Music: about 90 BPM boom-bap, crisp dusty snare, thick kick, a looping minor jazz electric-piano riff, dark and sparse, low upright bass, vinyl hiss. A short rising sci-fi synth blip before each ranking, drums slam back in after. Station ident feel, ends with a tape-stop.
exclude: singing, sung chorus, melodic hook, autotune, trap hi-hats, 808 glide, choir, female vocals, pop, EDM, rock guitar, record scratches
lyrics:
[Intro: station ident over the dark keys loop, Singer A low and close]
[Singer A, breathy]
Uh. Uh-huh.
Money printer manual. Page one. Take notes.

[Synth blip up] [Singer B, hype host: "Number one" / Singer A takes the line]
Number one: never tell 'em what you printed,
trillions out the back door, keep the ledger tinted.

[Synth blip up] [Singer B, hype host: "Number four" / Singer A takes the line]
Number four: never get high on your own supply,
banks took the first hit, now the rent's sky-high.

[Synth blip up] [Singer B, hype host: "Number six" / Singer A takes the line]
Number six: no credit? Nah, they live on the slate,
and you're paying it back in the price on your plate.

[Synth blip up] [Singer B, hype host: "Number seven" / Singer A takes the line]
Number seven: keep the family out the business,
Treasury and the bank in one bed, God as my witness.

[Synth blip up] [Singer B, hype host: "Number ten" / Singer A takes the line]
Number ten: no consignment, cash up front, that's law,
they took the bailout on tick and they ain't paid at all.

[Outro: drums out, keys only, Singer A spoken, nearly a whisper]
And the fix, from the future? Easy.
No hand on the printer.
[Sign-off sting, tape-stop]
title: tec-r1-radio-countdown-promo
